champions.bestiary.title: Bestiary
champions.bestiary.intro: Champions are elite monsters with a tier and special abilities called affixes. Get close to a champion to record its affixes here.
champions.bestiary.unknown: Not yet encountered. Get close to a champion with this affix to learn about it.
affix.arctic.desc: Fires homing ice projectiles that slow you down heavily.
affix.molten.desc: Fires homing fire projectiles that set you alight. Immune to fire.
affix.desecrating.desc: Every so often, leaves a cloud of harming under its target. Keep moving.
affix.plagued.desc: Poisons every creature that stays near it, and is immune to poison itself.
affix.infected.desc: Spawns silverfish every so often while it's fighting.
affix.adaptive.desc: Takes less and less damage from the same type of attack in a row. Switch weapons to break it.
affix.knocking.desc: Hits knock you far back and briefly slow you.
affix.shielding.desc: Periodically shields itself and takes no damage. Wait for the shield to drop.
affix.reflection.desc: Hurts and pushes back anyone who damages it.
affix.dampening.desc: Takes half damage from arrows, explosions, potions and other indirect attacks. Fight it up close.
affix.lively.desc: Regenerates health, and heals faster when it isn't fighting.
affix.blinded.desc: Its hits can blind you for a few seconds.
affix.paralyzing.desc: Its hits can root you in place for a few seconds.
affix.big.desc: Bigger, tougher and hits harder, but slower.
champions.bestiary.mobs.slimes: Slime and magma cube champions only
affix.horde_caller.desc: When it first spots you, 2-3 more zombies rise to join the fight.
affix.sunproof.desc: Doesn't burn in daylight, so it can hunt you during the day.
affix.sniper.desc: Fires more slowly, but its arrows are faster, perfectly aimed and deal +50% damage.
affix.volley.desc: Every few seconds fires a spread of 3 arrows.
affix.frost_archer.desc: Its arrows freeze you like powder snow.
affix.stalker.desc: Invisible until it starts to hiss. Watch for its swirling particles.
affix.webslinger.desc: Throws cobwebs that trap you where they land. The webs vanish after a few seconds.
affix.brood_mother.desc: Spawns cave spiders when it's hurt.
affix.pouncer.desc: Leaps at you from a distance.
affix.blink.desc: Teleports behind you after you hit it.
affix.thief.desc: Its hits can knock the item out of your hand.
affix.alchemist.desc: Also throws potions of Weakness, Mining Fatigue or Levitation.
affix.coven.desc: Arrives with 1-3 extra monsters and keeps healing nearby hostile mobs. Take it out first.
affix.inferno.desc: Its fireballs leave a patch of fire where they land.
affix.barrage.desc: Every few seconds unleashes an extra burst of fireballs.
affix.splitter.desc: Splits into more pieces when it dies. Some pieces keep one of its other affixes.
affix.warlord.desc: Arrives with 2-3 extra illagers, and nearby illagers get Strength while it lives.
affix.berserker.desc: Attacks faster the more it's hurt.
champions.bestiary.odds_note: Chance per hostile mob when a world starts. Odds rise as mobs get stronger over time.
champions.bestiary.difficulty_note: Easy and Peaceful are gentler, Hard is harsher. Change it in the game options.
champions.tooltip.tier1_affix_slots: Affix slots a tier 1 champion can fill
champions.tooltip.tier2_affix_slots: Affix slots a tier 2 champion can fill
champions.tooltip.tier3_affix_slots: Affix slots a tier 3 champion can fill
champions.tooltip.tier4_affix_slots: Affix slots a tier 4 champion can fill
champions.tooltip.tier5_affix_slots: Affix slots a tier 5 champion can fill
champions.tooltip.affix_slot_weight_bonu: Bigger affixes are picked more often when they fit: weight = 1 + bonus × (slots − 1)
champions.tooltip.affix_slots: How many of a champion's affix slots this affix takes up
champions.bestiary.affix_slots_text: Each champion tier has affix slots (tiers 1-5: %s). Stronger affixes take up more slots, so a tier 2 champion gets two 1-slot affixes or one 2-slot affix. Bigger affixes are picked more often when they fit.
champions.bestiary.loot_note: Any tier can drop an enchanted book, and higher tiers drop stronger ones. Only ★★★★★ books can have Mending.
affix.vampiric.desc: Heals for half the damage it deals to you.
affix.enraged.desc: Below 40% health it gets stronger and faster, and glows with red particles.
affix.withering.desc: Its hits and projectiles inflict Wither II.
affix.volatile.desc: Explodes 1.5 seconds after it dies. Back off after the killing blow.
affix.undying.desc: The first time it dies, it comes back at half health like a totem of undying.
affix.stormcaller.desc: Calls down lightning around you every few seconds. Keep moving.
